naslov: Golden State visits Minnesota after Edwards' 47-point game
tekst:
Golden State Warriors (1-3, 12th in the Western Conference) vs. Minnesota Timberwolves (3-1, sixth in the Western Conference)
              Minneapolis; Wednesday, 8 p.m. EDT
              BOTTOM LINE: Minnesota faces the Golden State Warriors after Anthony Edwards scored 47 points in the Minnesota Timberwolves' 127-125 overtime loss to the Cleveland Cavaliers.
              Minnesota finished 49-33 overall, 31-21 in Western Conference action and 26-15 at home during the 2025-26 season. The Timberwolves averaged 26.1 assists per game on 42.6 made field goals last season.
              Golden State finished 37-45 overall and 24-28 in Western Conference games during the 2025-26 season. The Warriors averaged 28.9 assists per game on 40.9 made field goals last season.
              INJURIES: Timberwolves: Donte DiVincenzo: out (achilles).
              Warriors: Moses Moody: out (knee), Kristaps Porzingis: out (illness), Jimmy Butler III: out (knee).
